name: preposterous_proportions_gives_your_creatures_plus_ten_plus_ten_and_vigilance_until_end_of_turn
notes: Printed: 'Creatures you control get +10/+10 and gain vigilance until end of turn.' Seat 0 casts Preposterous Proportions ({5}{G}{G}) in its first main phase with a 2/2 attacker and a 1/1 that stays home. Both get +10/+10 (12/12 and 11/11: power and toughness both +10), seat 1's creature keeps its printed size. The attacker attacks and, with vigilance, is still untapped afterwards (the home creature never attacked either), and being unblocked it deals 12 (seat 1: 20 -> 8). A creature that enters after the spell resolved (same turn) gets nothing (CR 611.2c): the late 1/1 stays 1/1.
